notes.title: STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar Digital Editions Detailed
notes.content:
The winds of change start with you! STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar is coming soon, and this latest trailer showcases even more of the wholesome adventures waiting for you in Zephyr Town. 

[previewyoutube=tHNfuL8EhL0;full]https://youtu.be/tHNfuL8EhL0[/previewyoutube]

Along with this new trailer, we’ve also got details about what’s included in the digital editions that will be available at launch. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558636/8b25d7b73b29d4ab6b24644455b6c0ea1848cfa5.jpg
STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar Digital Standard Edition ($49.99): 
 STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar base game 
 “Cow Set” cosmetic DLC: Cow Costume, Cow Headwear, Cow Glider 
STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar Digital Deluxe Edition ($59.98): 
 STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar base game 
 “Cow Set” cosmetic DLC: Cow Costume, Cow Headwear, Cow Glider 
 “Trunk of Transformation” cosmetic DLC: Chick Costume (Yellow), Chick Headwear (Yellow), Chick Costume (Black), Chick Headwear (Black), Alpaca Costume (White), Alpaca Headwear (White), Alpaca Costume (Brown), Alpaca Headwear (Brown), Ninja Outfit, Ninja Glider, Ninja Bazaar Set, Braid & Flowers, Cat Ear Buns with Highlights, Short Perm, Side Part with Highlights 
STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar Super Digital Deluxe Edition ($69.98): 
 Includes the contents of the Digital Deluxe Edition, plus: 
 STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar digital soundtrack 
 STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar digital art book 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558636/ff44fb853fb4b7e06cfbdffd0569d0043dd1ea42.jpg
STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar “Trunk of Transformation Bundle” DLC ($9.99): 
 “Trunk of Transformation” cosmetic DLC: Chick Costume (Yellow), Chick Headwear (Yellow), Chick Costume (Black), Chick Headwear (Black), Alpaca Costume (White), Alpaca Headwear (White), Alpaca Costume (Brown), Alpaca Headwear (Brown), Ninja Outfit, Ninja Glider, Ninja Bazaar Set, Braid & Flowers, Cat Ear Buns with Highlights, Short Perm, Side Part with Highlights 
STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar “Super Digital Deluxe DLC” Set ($19.99): 
 Includes the “Trunk of Transformation Bundle” DLC, plus: 
 STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar digital soundtrack 
 STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar digital art book 

Wishlist now and prepare to set up shop for your new life, when STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar arrives on August 27!

notes.title: Patch Notes 8/20/2020
notes.content:
We have released a new version of STORY OF SEASONS: Friends of Mineral Town.

BuildID: 5426390

This update addresses the following issues:
-When a character receives a disliked/hated item for the first time, dialogue specific to this situation would not display.
-For one dialogue line after the Moo-Moo Festival, Marie's name displays incorrectly as "Elly"
-Various minor text issues in English, German, and Spanish

notes.title: Patch notes 7/17/2020
notes.content:
We have released a new version of STORY OF SEASONS: Friends of Mineral Town.

BuildID: 5299674

We have received reports of users being unable to launch the game on Windows 10. We have determined the cause for some users and implemented a “Compatibility Mode” for the game which may fix the issue for affected users. Specifically, this mode will not use AVX to speed up processing, since it is incompatible with some older CPUs.

In order to launch in Compatibility Mode, please select “Play Compatibility Mode (互換モード)” from the launch options.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38037390/1af92db220d3b1a26b59f7a44670ba14cf571407.jpg

This mode can also be selected through the Configuration Tool, as a checkbox beneath the “Save & Launch” option.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38037390/05adaaa70fd7303187aba9dc5c73c923d93c1699.jpg

This mode will launch a separate executable file for the game, called “STORY OF SEASONS Friends of Mineral Town_Compatibility.exe”

If you have not had any issues running STORY OF SEASONS: Friends of Mineral Town until now, we do not recommend using Compatibility Mode.

We are continuing to investigate other issues reported with the configuration tool and with Windows 8.1 users. Thank you so much to users who have reported these issues and sent us more information. We really appreciate your patience.

Other Issues Addressed in this Update
 For some users, the Configuration Tool is launching in a different language than their system settings. We have not been able to reproduce this issue locally, but we have added the word (Language) in English to the language settings option in all languages, as well as written each language option in that language, in order to make the setting easier to find. We will continue to investigate this issue.
 Fixed an issue where certain daily conversation dialogue for Brandon would not trigger correctly.
 Made minor updates to the English, French, German, and Spanish text.
